1	    image: qgis/qgis-server:3.44.7-noble
     2	    container_name: qonnectra_qgis_server_dev
     3	    restart: unless-stopped
     4	    command: >
     5	      sh -c "
     6	        mkdir -p /etc/postgresql-common &&
     7	        cat > /etc/postgresql-common/pg_service.conf <<EOF
     8	      [${QGIS_PG_SERVICE_NAME:-qonnectra}]
     9	      host=db
    10	      port=5432
    11	      dbname=${DB_NAME}
    12	      user=${QGIS_DB_USER}
    13	      password=${QGIS_DB_PASSWORD}
    14	      sslmode=disable
    15	      EOF
    16	        mkdir -p /var/www/data/qgis &&
    17	        ln -sf /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi /var/www/data/qgis/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
    18	        rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock &&
    19	        fc-cache &&
    20	        /usr/bin/Xvfb :99 -ac -screen 0 1280x1024x16 +extension GLX +render -noreset >/dev/null &
    21	        sleep 2 &&
    22	        grep -q 'client_max_body_size' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf || sed -i '/http {/a \    client_max_body_size 500M;' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf &&
    23	        nginx &&
    24	        spawn-fcgi -F 2 -u www-data -g www-data -d /var/lib/qgis -P /run/qgis.pid -p 9993 -- /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
    25	        tail -f /dev/null
    26	      "
    27	    expose:
